Verses.VerseEn: Ha. Mim. (Only Allah and the Messenger [blessings and peace be upon him] know the real meaning.)

Verses.VerseAr: تَنۡزِيۡلُ الۡكِتٰبِ مِنَ اللّٰهِ الۡعَزِيۡزِ الۡحَكِيۡمِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: The revelation of (this) Book is from Allah, Almighty, Most Wise.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّ فِىۡ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ لَاٰيٰتٍ لِّلۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Indeed there are signs for the believers in the heavens and the earth.

Verses.VerseAr: وَفِىۡ خَلۡقِكُمۡ وَمَا يَبُثُّ مِنۡ دَآبَّةٍ اٰيٰتٌ لِّقَوۡمٍ يُّوۡقِنُوۡنَۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And in your (own) creation, and in the animals which He scatters, there are signs for those who believe with certitude.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاخۡتِلَافِ الَّيۡلِ وَالنَّهَارِ وَمَاۤ اَنۡزَلَ اللّٰهُ مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مِنۡ رِّزۡقٍ فَاَحۡيَا بِهِ الۡاَرۡضَ بَعۡدَ مَوۡتِهَا وَتَصۡرِيۡفِ الرِّيٰحِ اٰيٰتٌ لِّقَوۡمٍ يَّعۡقِلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And in the alternation of night and day and in that provision (of rain) which Allah sends down from the sky, and by that gives life to the earth after its death, and (in the same way) in changing the wind direction, there are Signs for those who apply reason.

Verses.VerseAr: تِلۡكَ اٰيٰتُ اللّٰهِ نَـتۡلُوۡهَا عَلَيۡكَ بِالۡحَقِّ‌ ‌ۚ فَبِاَىِّ حَدِيۡثِۭ بَعۡدَ اللّٰهِ وَاٰيٰتِهٖ يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: These are the Revelations of Allah which We recite to you with absolute Truth. Then what will they believe in after Allah and His Revelations?

Verses.VerseAr: وَيۡلٌ لِّـكُلِّ اَفَّاكٍ اَثِيۡمٍۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Woe to every liar given to fabricating false allegations (and) every dreadful evildoer,

Verses.VerseAr: يَّسۡمَعُ اٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ تُتۡلٰى عَلَيۡهِ ثُمَّ يُصِرُّ مُسۡتَكۡبِرًا كَاَنۡ لَّمۡ يَسۡمَعۡهَا‌ۚ فَبَشِّرۡهُ بِعَذَابٍ اَلِيۡمٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: The one who listens to the Revelations of Allah that are recited to him, then insists (on his disbelief) arrogantly as if he did not hear them, give him the news of a grievous torment.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِذَا عَلِمَ مِنۡ اٰيٰتِنَا شَيْئًا اتَّخَذَهَا هُزُوًا‌ؕ اُولٰٓٮِٕكَ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ مُّهِيۡنٌؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And when he learns about anything of Our Verses (of the Qur’an), he makes it a joke. It is they for whom there is humiliating torment.

Verses.VerseAr: مِّنۡ وَّرَآٮِٕهِمۡ جَهَنَّمُۚ وَلَا يُغۡنِىۡ عَنۡهُمۡ مَّا كَسَبُوۡا شَيْئًا وَّلَا مَا اتَّخَذُوۡا مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ اَوۡلِيَآءَ‌ ۚ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ عَظِيۡمٌؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Beyond (their current term of life), there is Hell. And (the worldly riches) which they have earned will be of no use to them. Nor will those idols be (of any benefit) that they have made guardians instead of Allah. And there is a very severe torment for them.

Verses.VerseAr: هٰذَا هُدًى‌ ‌ۚ وَالَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا بِاٰيٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ مِّنۡ رِّجۡزٍ اَلِيۡمٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: This (Qur’an) is guidance. And those who disbelieved in the Revelations of Allah, for them is in store extremely grievous torment.

Verses.VerseAr: اللّٰهُ الَّذِىۡ سَخَّرَ لَكُمُ الۡبَحۡرَ لِتَجۡرِىَ الۡفُلۡكُ فِيۡهِ بِاَمۡرِهٖ وَلِتَبۡتَغُوۡا مِنۡ فَضۡلِهٖ وَلَعَلَّكُمۡ تَشۡكُرُوۡنَ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Allah is the One Who has placed the sea under your control so that ships and vessels may sail in it by His Command, so that you may look for His bounty (i.e. sustenance through sea routes as well), and that you may become grateful (to Him).

Verses.VerseAr: وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمۡ مَّا فِىۡ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَمَا فِىۡ الۡاَرۡضِ جَمِيۡعًا مِّنۡهُ‌ؕ اِنَّ فِىۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍ لِّقَوۡمٍ يَّتَفَكَّرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And He has made subservient to you, out of His will, whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth, all of it (under a system). Surely there are Signs in it for those who ponder.

Verses.VerseAr: قُل لِّلَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا يَغۡفِرُوۡا لِلَّذِيۡنَ لَا يَرۡجُوۡنَ اَيَّامَ اللّٰهِ لِيَجۡزِىَ قَوۡمًۢا بِمَا كَانُوۡا يَكۡسِبُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Say to the believers to disregard those who neither hope for nor fear (the coming of) the Days of Allah, so that He may give them full reward of those (deeds) which they used to earn.

Verses.VerseAr: مَنۡ عَمِلَ صَالِحًـا فَلِنَفۡسِهٖ‌ۚ وَمَنۡ اَسَآءَ فَعَلَيۡهَا‌ ثُمَّ اِلٰى رَبِّكُمۡ تُرۡجَعُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Whoever does a righteous work does it for (the benefit of) his own soul and whoever commits some evil act, then he alone is to face (suffering caused by it). Then all of you will be returned to your Lord.

Words.MeaningEn: then it is for his soul

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَقَدۡ اٰتَيۡنَا بَنِىۡۤ اِسۡرآءِيۡلَ الۡكِتٰبَ وَالۡحُكۡمَ وَالنُّبُوَّةَ وَرَزَقۡنٰهُمۡ مِّنَ الطَّيِّبٰتِ وَفَضَّلۡنٰهُمۡ عَلَى الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And surely We gave to the Children of Israel the Book, the regime and Prophethood and provided them with sustenance of pure things. And We exalted them above (their contemporary) worlds (i.e. the nations and civilizations of that age).

Verses.VerseAr: وَاٰتَيۡنٰهُمۡ بَيِّنٰتٍ مِّنَ الۡاَمۡرِ‌ ۚ فَمَا اخۡتَلَفُوۡۤا اِلَّا مِنۡۢ بَعۡدِ مَا جَآءَهُمُ الۡعِلۡمُ ۙ بَغۡيًاۢ بَيۡنَهُمۡ‌ؕ اِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَقۡضِىۡ بَيۡنَهُمۡ يَوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِ فِيۡمَا كَانُوۡا فِيۡهِ يَخۡتَلِفُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And We gave them clear proofs of religion (and Prophethood). But they disagreed (about it) after the knowledge (of raising the Prophet Muhammad) had come to them, merely because of their mutual jealousy, spite and antagonism. Surely your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Judgment concerning the matter in which they used to disagree.

Verses.VerseAr: ثُمَّ جَعَلۡنٰكَ عَلٰى شَرِيۡعَةٍ مِّنَ الۡاَمۡرِ فَاتَّبِعۡهَا وَلَا تَتَّبِعۡ اَهۡوَآءَ الَّذِيۡنَ لَا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then We set you on the open path of Shari‘a (Islamic Law). So follow it persistently. And do not yield to the desires of those who are simply unaware (of the glory, dignity and trueness of your Din [Religion]).

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّهُمۡ لَنۡ يُّغۡنُوۡا عَنۡكَ مِنَ اللّٰهِ شَيْئًا ؕ وَاِنَّ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ بَعۡضُهُمۡ اَوۡلِيَآءُ بَعۡضٍ‌ ۚ وَّاللّٰهُ وَلِىُّ الۡمُتَّقِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Surely these people will not be of any help to you at all (despite promises) from Allah (for crucial time of hardships coming in the way of Islam). And in truth the wrongdoers (in the world) are friends and helpers only to one another and Allah is the Friend and Helper of the Godfearing.

Verses.VerseAr: هٰذَا بَصَاٮِٕرُ لِلنَّاسِ وَهُدًى وَّرَحۡمَةٌ لِّقَوۡمٍ يُّوۡقِنُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: This (Qur’an) contains proofs, which provide vision and lessons of warning to the people, and is Guidance and Mercy for those who believe with certitude.

Verses.VerseAr: اَمۡ حَسِبَ الَّذِيۡنَ اجۡتَرَحُوۡا السَّيِّاٰتِ اَنۡ نَّجۡعَلَهُمۡ كَالَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوۡا الصّٰلِحٰتِ ۙ سَوَآءً مَّحۡيَاهُمۡ وَمَمَاتُهُمۡ‌ؕ سَآءَ مَا يَحۡكُمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Do those who have earned evil deeds think that We will make them resemble those who believe and do good deeds (so as) to make their life and death alike? The claim, which they (the disbelievers) make, is the worst evil.

Verses.VerseAr: وَخَلَقَ اللّٰهُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضَ بِالۡحَقِّ وَلِتُجۡزٰى كُلُّ نَفۡسٍۢ بِمَا كَسَبَتۡ وَهُمۡ لَا يُظۡلَمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And Allah created the heavens and the earth with (a strategy based on) Truth in order that every soul is rewarded for the deeds that it earns and they will not be wronged.

Verses.VerseAr: اَفَرَءَيۡتَ مَنِ اتَّخَذَ اِلٰهَهٗ هٰوٮهُ وَاَضَلَّهُ اللّٰهُ عَلَىٰ عِلۡمٍ وَّخَتَمَ عَلَىٰ سَمۡعِهٖ وَقَلۡبِهٖ وَجَعَلَ عَلٰى بَصَرِهٖ غِشٰوَةً ؕ فَمَنۡ يَّهۡدِيۡهِ مِنۡۢ بَعۡدِ اللّٰهِ‌ؕ اَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Have you seen him who has made his desire his god and Allah has held him astray despite his knowledge and has sealed his ears and his heart and has blindfolded his eyes? Then who can guide him after Allah? So do you not accept advice?

Verses.VerseAr: وَقَالُوۡا مَا هِىَ اِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا الدُّنۡيَا نَمُوۡتُ وَنَحۡيَا وَمَا يُهۡلِكُنَاۤ اِلَّا الدَّهۡرُ‌ؕ وَمَا لَهُمۡ بِذٰلِكَ مِنۡ عِلۡمٍ‌ ۚ اِنۡ هُمۡ اِلَّا يَظُنُّوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And they say: ‘There is nothing (else) except our worldly life. We die and live here (only). And nothing kills us except (circumstances and occurrences of) time (i.e. they deny Allah and the Hereafter absolutely). And they simply do not have any knowledge of this (reality). They follow only their speculation and assumption.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِذَا تُتۡلٰى عَلَيۡهِمۡ اٰيٰتُنَا بَيِّنٰتٍ مَّا كَانَ حُجَّتَهُمۡ اِلَّاۤ اَنۡ قَالُوۡا ائۡتُوۡا بِاٰبَآٮِٕنَاۤ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ صٰدِقِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And when Our clear Verses are recited to them, they do not have any plea except to say: ‘Bring back our fathers (raised alive) if you are truthful.’

Verses.VerseAr: قُلِ اللّٰهُ يُحۡيِيۡكُمۡ ثُمَّ يُمِيۡتُكُمۡ ثُمَّ يَجۡمَعُكُمۡ اِلٰى يَوۡمِ الۡقِيٰمَةِ لَا رَيۡبَ فِيۡهِ وَلٰكِنَّ اَكۡثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Say: ‘Allah is the One Who gives you life and He is the One Who causes you to die. Then He will gather all of you towards the Day of Resurrection about which there is no doubt. But most people do not know.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَلِلّٰهِ مُلۡكُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ‌ؕ وَيَوۡمَ تَقُوۡمُ السَّاعَةُ يَوۡمَٮِٕذٍ يَّخۡسَرُ الۡمُبۡطِلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And the Kingdom of the heavens and the earth belongs to Allah alone. And the Day when the Last Hour comes, then (all) the disbelievers will run into serious loss.

Verses.VerseAr: وَتَرٰى كُلَّ اُمَّةٍ جَاثِيَةً‌ كُلُّ اُمَّةٍ تُدۡعَىٰۤ اِلٰى كِتٰبِهَا ؕ الۡيَوۡمَ تُجۡزَوۡنَ مَا كُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And you will see every party (of the disbelievers and beliers) sitting, fallen on their knees. Every community will be called to its book (of deeds): ‘You will be rewarded Today for the deeds that you used to do.

Verses.VerseAr: هٰذَا كِتٰبُنَا يَنۡطِقُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ بِالۡحَقِّ‌ؕ اِنَّا كُنَّا نَسۡتَنۡسِخُ مَا كُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: This is Our record that will speak about you with absolute truth. Verily We used to (preserve) by getting transcribed what you used to do.’

Verses.VerseAr: فَاَمَّا الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوۡا الصّٰلِحٰتِ فَيُدۡخِلُهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ فِىۡ رَحۡمَتِهٖ‌ؕ ذٰلِكَ هُوَ الۡفَوۡزُ الۡمُبِيۡنُ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So those who believe and do good deeds, their Lord will admit them to His Mercy. That is nothing but an evident success.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاَمَّا الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡۤا اَفَلَمۡ تَكُنۡ اٰيٰتِىۡ تُتۡلٰى عَلَيۡكُمۡ فَاسۡتَكۡبَرۡتُمۡ وَكُنۡتُمۡ قَوۡمًا مُّجۡرِمِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And those who disbelieved (it will be said to them:) ‘Were My Verses not recited to you? But you showed arrogance and you were the evildoers.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِذَا قِيۡلَ اِنَّ وَعۡدَ اللّٰهِ حَقٌّ وَّالسَّاعَةُ لَا رَيۡبَ فِيۡهَا قُلۡتُمۡ مَّا نَدۡرِىۡ مَا السَّاعَةُۙ اِنۡ نَّظُنُّ اِلَّا ظَنًّا وَّمَا نَحۡنُ بِمُسۡتَيۡقِنِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And when it was said: ‘The promise of Allah is true and there is no doubt about (the coming of) the Last Hour,’ you used to say: ‘We do not know what the Last Hour is, nor do we have any faith in it.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَبَدَا لَهُمۡ سَيِّاٰتُ مَا عَمِلُوۡا وَحَاقَ بِهِمۡ مَّا كَانُوۡا بِهٖ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And all their evil works will be exposed which they used to do, and that (torment) will beset them which they used to make fun of.

Verses.VerseAr: وَقِيۡلَ الۡيَوۡمَ نَنۡسٰٮكُمۡ كَمَا نَسِيۡتُمۡ لِقَآءَ يَوۡمِكُمۡ هٰذَا وَمَاۡوٰٮكُمُ النَّارُ وَمَا لَكُمۡ مِّنۡ نّٰصِرِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And it will be said (to them): ‘Today We forget you as you forgot your Meeting on this Day. And Hell is your abode and there will be no helper for you.

Verses.VerseAr: ذٰلِكُمۡ بِاَنَّكُمُ اتَّخَذۡتُمۡ اٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ هُزُوًا وَّغَرَّتۡكُمُ الۡحَيٰوةُ الدُّنۡيَا‌ ۚ فَالۡيَوۡمَ لَا يُخۡرَجُوۡنَ مِنۡهَا وَلَا هُمۡ يُسۡتَعۡتَبُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: That (is) so because you made fun of Allah’s Revelations, and the worldly life deceived you.’ So Today neither will they be taken out of that (Hell), nor will be accepted from them any attempt to seek (Allah’s) pleasure by means of repentance.

Verses.VerseAr: فَلِلّٰهِ الۡحَمۡدُ رَبِّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَرَبِّ الۡاَرۡضِ رَبِّ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So all praise belongs to Allah alone Who is the Lord of the heavens and the Master of the earth (and also) the Sustainer of all the worlds.

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَهُ الۡكِبۡرِيَآءُ فِىۡ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ‌ وَهُوَ الۡعَزِيۡزُ الۡحَكِيۡمُ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And all Greatness (i.e. Eminence) in the heavens and the earth belongs to Him alone and He is the One Who is Almighty, Most Wise.
